name: sanchivue
description: Sanchivue — Live Technical Interview & AI Assessment Platform. Pure JavaScript MERN stack (React + Vite + Express + MongoDB + Mongoose + Socket.io). Created by Sanchit Singhal.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && bun install && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n backend,frontend "cd backend && bun run lint" "cd frontend && bun run lint"
scripts.format: concurrently -n backend,frontend "cd backend && bun run format" "cd frontend && bun run format"

author: Sanchit Singhal
